territorial_scope.description: Applies to interconnection and connection to Mexico's Red Nacional de Transmisión and Redes Generales de Distribución within the national electricity system.

evidence.quote: es aplicable para:

summary.short: Mexico's Comisión Nacional de Energía issues a model contract for interconnecting or connecting power plants, storage systems and load centers to the national transmission or general distribution networks, signed by CFE and the applicant. It takes effect the business day after DOF publication and repeals four earlier CRE instruments.
summary.long: The Comisión Nacional de Energía (CNE) issues a model contract for interconnecting, connecting or both power plants, storage systems and load centers to the Red Nacional de Transmisión or the Redes Generales de Distribución. It covers generation and storage permit holders, load centers, and self-consumer or qualified users, with a 1 MW contracted-load threshold for load centers on distribution networks (Art. 2). Contracts are signed by CFE as transmitter or distributor and the applicant, on CENACE instruction, and set out measurement systems, maintenance, guarantees, works, term, termination, force majeure and dispute resolution through the Market Rules. Performance under the contract may be suspended in emergencies (Cl. Vigésima Segunda) and, when measurement systems cannot be reviewed, a fixed monthly payment applies as a penalty (Cl. Vigésima Séptima). Modifications that change the model require prior CNE approval; other addenda do not. Generation under 0.7 MW in Generación Distribuida is excluded from this model. The agreement enters into force the business day after DOF publication and repeals four earlier CRE instruments.
